messages.content: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk are in stock. Then find a couple of popular alternatives in the audio category and format those recommendation details into a readable summary. After that, scan my living_room devices for user_id u_alice, check the current status of the living room light device_id light_living, and use that to set its brightness property to 70 using config_value 70. Then find the discovered smart lock there, archive that lock discovery as “Living Room Lock Archive,” and create a shopping-and-IoT summary document from that archive. Finally, send me an alert through the app channel with medium priority.
